notes: v2.9.37: breakout, pullback and Bowl-3 marker placement is tightened. Generic breakout markers now require the current bullish candle BODY to cross the relevant EMA112/224 and the concrete/previous-high structure itself; a gap opening already above those levels is not marked as a breakout. Breakout volume must also meet the configured breakout-volume threshold (default 3x versus the previous bar or prior 20-bar average). Pullback markers now require a bearish low-volume candle after the breakout, the former structure top must remain supported on close, and the marker is pinned to the support actually tested: concrete top, previous-high top, EMA112 or EMA224. The chart label now shows that exact support. Bowl-3 keeps the user's strict 224 bullish-body-breakout -> bearish pullback definition, but when one candle touches multiple valid supports it labels the support nearest the actual candle low rather than whichever support happened to be checked first. Historical Bowl-3 labels now include the actual support source as well. Watermelon, accumulation, condition-search, zoom and live-order rules remain unchanged.
